promptIntro: A prompt tells the AI how your organisation replies: its tone, its rules. One is ready. Read it, make it yours, and add others now or later in Prompts.
workIntro: An email goes through two steps before you reply: it is sorted, then a reply is written. Choose what the AI does at each, for every member of the organisation. Whatever you choose, nothing is sent without someone’s confirmation.
needsKey: Needs an AI key, which was not given.
workLater: These two choices can be changed at any time in Settings → Organisation.
finish: Apply and open a first email
tryIt: This is your first email here. Write a few words on what to answer, or nothing at all, then “Write with”. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
tryPrepared: This is your first email here, with the proposal prepared for it. Read it, change what you want, then Send. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
sortingIntro: When emails are fetched, which ones need a reply?
sortingNoneHint: Every email of the watched folder is to handle. Nothing is sent to the AI at this step.
sortingAiHint: It sets aside what needs no reply, marks what is urgent and suggests a prompt. It reads the sender, the subject, the beginning of the text and attachment names. You can always put an email back.
writingIntro: For an email to handle, when does the AI write a proposal of reply?
writingNoneHint: I open the email and ask for a proposal, or write myself. The content of an email is sent to the AI only then.
writingDraftHint: A proposal waits for me in each email to handle. Their content is sent to the AI without anyone asking.
writingMailbox: At fetch, as drafts in the mailbox
writingMailboxHint: The same, and each proposal is filed in the Drafts folder of the mailbox, to finish and send from my mail client.
